title: Attricat extension form assist answer v1
description: What an extension's form_assist command answers for one open record form. The host checks each proposal against its attribute and applies it as an unsaved form change, only to a declared proposes field the user has not edited. Proposals for other fields, and values the attribute refuses, are dropped. Notes are plain text, never markup.

proposals.description: At most one proposal per field; an empty list proposes nothing.

attribute_code.description: One of the assist's declared proposes fields.

value.description: The value in the attribute's JSON form, as the record API writes it.

note.description: Why the value is proposed, shown under the field.
